caseName: United States Department of State v. Washington Post Co.
caseNameFull: United States Department of State v. Washington Post Co.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 812.] Judgment vacated and case remanded to the Court of Appeals with directions that it instruct the United States District Court for the District of Columbia to dismiss the complaint as moot.
